paite: Huan TOUPA hehna Israelte tung ah ahong tung nawn hi. Amaute kalh a David tokthou in, "Kuan inla, Israel mite leh Judah mite sim vek in," achi hi.
heading: David In Kisimpina Abawl / (1 Kro 21.1-27)

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang a om sepaih heutu Joab kiang ah, "Israel nam tengteng lak ah Dan a pan Beer-sheba pha in vialvak inla, mi bangzah ahi ua ka theihtheihna ding in sim vek in," achi hi.
Joab in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in mite pungsak in bangzah a tam, amun za leng, toupa ka pu in muta ve, himahleh toupa ka kumpipa'n bangziak a huai thei ut se ahia?" achi hi.
Himahleh kumpipa thu in Joab leh sepaih heutute thu azouta hi. Huchi in Joab leh sepaih heutute Israel mite sim ding in kumpipa kiang a pan apaikheta uhi.
Jordan gal ava kah ua, Gad Phaizang laitak taklam a khopi om Aroer ah Jazer pha in om mun akhoh uhi.
Gilead gam leh Tahtim-hodshi gam atung ua; Dan-jaan leh Zidon kimvel atung uhi.
Tura kulh leh Hiv mite kho tengteng leh Kanaan mite kho tengteng ava tung ua; Beer-sheba a, Judah simlam ah apaikhia uhi.
Huchi in gam tengteng atotsuah khit uh, kha kua leh ni sawmnih abei in Jerusalem ahong tungkik uhi.
Joab in mihing phazah kumpipa apia a; Israel gam ah namsau tawi mihangsan nuaigiat a-om uhi. Judah mi bel nuainga a-om hi.

Mihing asim khit un David lungtang anuam het kei. David in TOUPA kiang ah, "Ka thilhih ah nakpitak in ka na khialta hi. Himahleh tu in aw TOUPA, na sikha thulimlouhna koihmang ding in ka hon ngen hi. Haihuai mahmah in ka na hihta," achi hi.
Zingsang a David athohleh David zawlnei Gad kiang ah TOUPA thu ana tung hi.
"Kuan inla, David kiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Thil thum ka hon tah a, na tung a ka hih ding in khat tel in, achi,' " chi in.

Huchi in David kiang ah Gad ahoh a, ahilh a, akiang ah, "Na gam a na tung a kum sagih sung kial akiak hia? Na melmate'n hon delh ua kha thum sung amau a pan na taimang hia? Na gam a ni thum sung hipi ahong len? Hon sawlpa bangchi in ka dawng dia? Kingaihtuah inla, hon hilh in," achi hi.
David in Gad kiang ah, "Ka lung azing mahmah mai hi. TOUPA khut sung ah hon puklutsak in; azahngaihna lah athupi mahmah ngal a. Mihing khut sung ah zaw hon puklutsak ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Israel mite tung ah zingsang a pan hun seh tan hipi alengsak hi. Huchi in Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan mi singsagih asi uh.

Angel in hihse dia Jerusalem lam a, akhut alikleh TOUPA'N thil hoih lou hih atup alunghei thak a, mite hihmangpa angel kiang ah, "Ahunta; na khut lik nawn ke'n," achi hi. TOUPA angel bel Jebus mi Araunah phual chin ah a-om hi.

David in mi that angel amuh in TOUPA ahoupih a, "Ngai in, ka na khialta, dikloutak in thil ka na hihta hi. Himahleh hiai belamte'n bang ahih ua? Na khut in kei leh ka pa inkote hon khoih zaw hen," achi hi.
Huai ni in David kiang ah Gad ahoh a, akiang ah, "Kuantou inla, Jebus mi Araunah phual ah TOUPA a ding in maitam va doh in," achi hi.
heading: Araunah Phual A David Maitam

paite: Huchi in David, TOUPA thupiak bang a Gad in ahilh bang in akuantouta hi.
Araunah in amalam a-etleh, amah lam zuan a kumpipa leh asikhate hong pai amu hi. Huchi in Araunah apawt a, amai a lei si in kumpipa ma ah abokkhup hi.

Araunah in, "Bang achia ahia toupa ka kumpipa, asikha kiang a ahong?" achi hi. David in, "Mipite lak a hipi akhawltheihna dia TOUPA a dia maitam doh ding a na phual lei ding in ahi ka hong pai," achi hi.
Araunah in David kiang ah, "Toupa ka kumpipa'n hoih asak bang in la henla, lan hen: En in, halmang a lat ding in bawngtalte a-om ua, sing ding in phual vanzatte leh bawng vante a-om uhi.
Aw toupa, hiai tengteng Araunah in kumpipa ape vek hi," achi hi. Araunah in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in hon dawng hen," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n Araunah kiang ah, "Hilou e, aman pia in ka hon lei teitei ding ahi. Kei lam a bangmah senna om lou in TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah halmang thillatte ka lan kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in David in phual leh bawngtalte dangka shekel sawmnga in aleita hi.
David in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan hi. Huchi in TOUPA agam tung ah alungkimta a, Israel gam a pan hipi akhawlta hi.
